description: Replacing the built-in glyphs of the Svelte 5 data grid with your own icon set. Every icon the grid draws for its chrome has a name, and the icons prop is a map from name to snippet, so names you leave out keep their built-in glyph; a partial set is a complete answer. Toggle Ours, Mixed and Yours to see Mixed override four icons while the rest of the chrome carries on. Overrides can be SVG, a design-system icon component, an image or a character, sized by the grid and coloured through currentColor.
keywords: svelte table replace sort filter icons

faq.question: How do I replace one icon?
faq.answer: Pass icons={{ filter: myFunnel }} where myFunnel is a snippet. Only the filter glyph changes; sort, menu, pager and expander keep their defaults.

faq.question: Do I have to size or colour the override?
faq.answer: No. The grid sizes the icon box so an override lands at the same size as the glyph it replaces, and the colour follows currentColor. The expander override also rotates when a group opens.

faq.question: Which package is this in?
faq.answer: The icons prop is part of the MIT @svgrid/grid package, and the same map applies to the tool panel and pager icons when those are shown.
